title: The Dragon Bard
text: A bard who sings only of dragons sits on a scorched rock, his lute strung with something that glitters. He knows every dragon by name and has outlived the songs of a dozen heroes. He wants to hear your story, so he can decide how it ends.

options.label: The best talker tells him your story.

outcomes.text: He makes a song of it, a good one, with dragons in it. Your House will be famous, and he decides how it ends.

options.label: Ask him which dragon rules here.

outcomes.text: He tells you her name, and her temper, and her one weakness, and then plays a sad chord.
He sings of you anyway, badly, and the song travels home ahead of you. People will hum it at the Leader's House.
He sings of you anyway, loudly, and the kind of thing that lives in these hills hears it.
